dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Primary 'O' and 'C' structures exhibit thin, high-intensity perimeters with high-frequency serration and irregular curvature. There is a sharp, binary-like gradient transition from the narrow light-grey outer boundary to the wide, dark-grey interior.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of solid high-intensity clusters; high-intensity pixels are primarily confined to the perimeter filaments of the macro-annuli. Discrete low-intensity pixel clusters are concentrated within the geometric centers of the largest ring structures.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent macro-annuli in the mid-dorsal region form an asymmetrical, elongated quadrilateral arrangement, with the interior angles roughly approximating 70, 110, 85, and 95 degrees.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple high-intensity, divergent linear filament structures protruding from the anterior-ventral extremity of the subject.
